objective: Seed deterministic validation data from current repo examples and run end-to-end acceptance checks for capture, meeting review, exchange, search, and reporting in the mobile package.
environment_prerequisites: Flutter SDK is installed and available on PATH.
The mobile package can run flutter test locally.
The existing SQLite-backed app database remains local-only.
required_commands: cd mobile/field_work_agent && flutter test test/acceptance_workflows_test.dart test/meeting_fallback_shell_test.dart test/smoke_test.dart
success_criteria: Pompallier Ponsonby validation data is seeded from current repo examples in a deterministic fixture.
One sample meeting scenario is available for automated acceptance checks.
Acceptance coverage verifies text capture to final task, meeting audio to reviewed meeting and task candidates, export/import round-trip, and search/report behavior on created records.
The acceptance path stays local-only and does not add sync or hosted backend assumptions.
stop_conditions: Flutter test cannot exercise the local SQLite/database path and the remaining work would require adding a new dependency just to run acceptance checks.
Completing the acceptance path would require changes to canonical product docs rather than implementation and test artifacts.
approval_gates: Adding new runtime dependencies beyond what the mobile package already uses.
Expanding acceptance scope into remote AI providers or network-backed infrastructure.
deliverables: End-to-end acceptance tests for core local workflows
notes: Prefer driving real application services over duplicating logic in tests.
Keep the acceptance fixture anchored to TASKS.md, the meeting JSON contract examples, and the sample bundle values already in the repo.
